column1: # Every moment Claude Code offers a harness, and Felix's stance on each.
# This file exists because two coverage gaps were found by a person noticing.
# The Stop hook checked the gate and never asked anyone to verify their claims;
# SubagentStop was not wired at all, so a subagent could finish, report success,
# and be believed. Both are the same defect — a completion moment with nothing
# at it — and neither was findable by reading the code, because absence has no
# A stance is required for every event. `wired` must be backed by an entry in
# hooks.json, and `declined` must carry a reason someone can argue with. An
# event with neither is the gap, and `felix coverage` fails on it.
# The point is not the current answers. It is that a new event added by the
# platform, or a hook quietly removed, cannot sit here unnoticed.
